description: This is a PHP source file defining the Framework class within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends Symfony's HttpKernel and sets up core components such as dependency injection, routing, logging, and request handling for the application.

classes.name: Framework
classes.description: The Framework class initializes and manages core components such as routing, logging, event dispatching, and request handling within the OrangeHRM application, extending Symfony's HttpKernel.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the framework environment, debug mode, and sets up core services and components.

methods.name: configureContainer
methods.description: Sets up dependency injection containers with core services like request stack, event dispatcher, controller resolver, argument resolver, entity manager, and authentication chain.

methods.name: configureLogger
methods.description: Configures application-wide logging by registering the Logger service and subscribing to logging events.

methods.name: configureRouter
methods.description: Sets up routing components including route matching, URL generation, and request context based on the incoming request.

methods.name: configurePlugins
methods.description: Loads and initializes plugins based on configuration files.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Handles an incoming HTTP request, sets up routing and plugins, then processes the request through the parent HttpKernel.

methods.name: isDebug
methods.description: Returns whether the application is running in debug mode.
